title: JANUS Linear A canonical research state after typed-token corrective replay

canonicality.rule: New canonical states supersede prior states for current inference but retain all prior receipts, failures, and corrective audits as immutable history.

separation_of_responsibility.research/linear_a/: Executable parsers, statistical runners, corrective policies, replay orchestrators, and future independent implementations.
separation_of_responsibility.data/: Persistent machine-readable research state, immutable results, failure audits, connection candidates, claim ceilings, and roadmaps.
separation_of_responsibility.GitHub Actions artifacts: Ephemeral execution receipts with exact run/artifact digests; permanent data nodes store their provenance and scientific summary.

promotion_gate.meaning: A statistically strong result is not promotable when its identity is punctuation, a numeric literal, a known control, an unresolved representation, or another ontologically invalid candidate class.

execution_history.scientific_note: Produced a strong *900 row-initial depletion signal later falsified as punctuation/boundary-marker evidence.
Removed punctuation before scoring; exposed a second type-boundary leak when ¹⁄₅ entered semantic candidate space.

current_authoritative_evidence_chain.name: TYPED_TOKEN_CORRECTIVE_REPLAY_v0.6.2
current_authoritative_evidence_chain.why_authoritative: It repeats v0.1-v0.6 with both punctuation and numeric-literal type boundaries enforced before hashing, candidate construction, null generation, and record-role geometry.

v0.2.2.interpretation: Strong infrastructure/control success; not a novelty result.

falsified_or_blocked_paths.reason: Known accounting families absorb the dominant signal.
Known personnel-class structure plus unresolved modifier/sign identity.

infrastructure_successes: Frozen corpus provenance with exact commit.
True train-only candidate discovery followed by locked held-out testing.
Family-wise error correction via max-T and Bonferroni gates.
Post-score semantic reveal rather than semantic preselection.
Known-structure rediscovery remained stable after representation cleanup.
Strong *900 statistical evidence was rejected after ontology/identity reveal instead of being promoted by p-value alone.
Representation defects triggered full corrective replays rather than local post-hoc exclusions.
Typed semantic candidate universe now excludes punctuation and numeric literals before all future blind scoring.
scientific_non_successes: No new Linear A lexical anchor has passed the full promotion gate.
No novel cross-region numeric survivor remains after known-family subtraction and typed cleanup.
No novel cross-region record-role survivor remains after typed cleanup.

connection_candidates_generated_by_proce.name: TYPED_CANDIDATE_SPACE_IS_A_PRECONDITION_FOR_VALID_BLIND_DISCOVERY
connection_candidates_generated_by_proce.statement: Blindness protects against semantic cherry-picking only after the candidate universe itself is ontologically typed; otherwise the system may honestly discover punctuation or numerals as if they were semantic symbols.
connection_candidates_generated_by_proce.generalization_gate: Require independent demonstration in another domain before promoting to cross-domain JANUS Connection.

current_research_question: After typing punctuation and numeric literals out of semantic candidate space, can an anonymous semantic token or token-neighborhood relation exhibit a formula-transition/document-role effect that survives destructive nulls and non-HT cross-region replication?

roadmap.action: Freeze JANUS-LINA-TOKEN-TYPING-POLICY-v0.6.2 as mandatory precondition for future Linear A discovery.
Implement formula-transition / predecessor-successor / neighborhood-role discovery on semantic candidates only.
roadmap.promotion_rule: No semantic reveal until candidate identity, relation type, effect direction, and replication test are frozen.

roadmap.action: Replay any v0.7 survivor under alternative row/word segmentation so it cannot depend on one transcription layout convention.
Introduce an independently curated Linear A transcription/parser source for genuinely external replication.
Reimplement the winning analysis independently and replay frozen candidate IDs/transforms/scoring.
Only after structural survival, test morphological family consistency, alternative segmentation, and competing lexical/language-family explanations.
Requires multiple independently replicated anchors, grammar-level predictive success, broad corpus coverage, and competing-language-family falsification.

project_tracking.reason_not_complete: The success condition requires at least one nontrivial new candidate to survive the full promotion gate; none currently does.
